data.name: Amble
data.gender_notes: Amble is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word amblos, meaning 'steadfast' or 'enduring'. In Christian tradition, Amble represents the unwavering faith and devotion of the faithful. The name Amble carries the meaning “Steadfast, enduring” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Amble usually hope their child will grow to embody steadfast, enduring and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of steadfastness and perseverance in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Amble belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Steadfast, enduring.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amble total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Amble" signifies the idea of taking steady, enduring steps in life, much like a pilgrim on a long and arduous journey. Historically, the name has been little used in Christian communities, but it carries an inherently hopeful and resilient meaning.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian spirituality, the name "Amble" symbolizes the inner strength and unwavering faith that keeps one anchored during life's most challenging and uncertain moments. It reminds us of God's constant presence and the assurance that He will provide the sustenance needed to endure and remain steadfast in our beliefs. The name is a reminder of the importance of holding on to one's faith, even when the path ahead may be shrouded in darkness.
